input.prompt: A colored-pencil drawing on cream paper comes to life, a hand-drawn pencil drawing in every frame: same pencil lines, paper texture and hatching as the first frame, never a photo or 3D. She sings the words of the reference audio, 'I just ask myself what it is that I need', lips exactly in time with the voice: mouth opening on 'I', a short rounded 'j' on 'just', open on 'ask', lips pressing together on the 'm' of 'myself'. She performs like a real singer in a music video, feeling the song: she sings with her whole upper body, shoulders and chest moving, her body swaying side to side on the beat, her head bobbing and tilting freely, turning slightly toward the viewer and away again; her eyebrows rise and fall, her eyes look up and to the side, close briefly on a long note and open again. Lively, natural, continuous motion like live footage of a singer, never a still body with only a moving mouth; she stays roughly in place. She sings it softly and thoughtfully, a small honest shrug of her shoulders on 'I just ask myself', her eyes searching up and to the side as if reading a screen, then turning inward; a cool blue screen glow lights her face. The grid and wireframe cubes behind her stay still. Same person as in the first frame: large head, heart-shaped face, soft chin, tall forehead with the high centre-parted hairline, the two slightly different eyebrows, the same big dark-brown eyes; do not restyle her face. Her hair stays up in the bun with the two yellow pencils crossing through it in an X, both eraser caps pointing up (one blue, one pink); the pencils move only together with her head and never fall. Headphones stay round her neck; the white jacket keeps its orange bands, ONE small pale-blue chest dot exactly where it is in the first frame and ONE 1420 MHz sleeve patch. Static camera, same framing, no zoom. No captions, no text, no new objects.
